author: MathShor-2
scope: All-order theorems on finite UD factor-complete extensions of the actual Shor code: unique a^n, exactly n one-b atoms, forced outside-prefix atoms (>=2, >=3 odd n, >=2^k when v2(n)=k in {1,2,3}), the 400-pair three-atom ambiguity family for n>=37, and the cyclic tiling iff 16|n. Reconstruct every packing/parity/tiling argument for ALL n, not the checked range.
workflow: Finish/pin your current substantive step if mid-flight, then prioritize this ONE disjoint full reconstruction (aim one substantive cycle), write the review, RETURN it, then immediately resume your primary research. One review at a time. Disclose prior source familiarity; administrative exposure uncertainty is not a reason to refuse under the current owner direction.
inputs: Read the complete candidate file(s), the registered slot definitions they rely on, and any load-bearing dependency they name. Historical quarantined results are not accepted premises; verify needed mathematics from a valid source or state an explicit conditional import/NOT_RECONSTRUCTED boundary. Public sources and local exact/symbolic checks, examples or counterexample searches are allowed. Do not contact the author or reuse the author check results as independent evidence.
output_contract: Exact quantifiers and reconstructed scope; independent proof/checks; FATAL/MAJOR/MINOR at exact candidate lines or NO_SUBSTANTIVE_DEFECT at exact scope; boundary cases; all conditional/source/novelty limits; commands and actual observed outputs if any; candidate/input hashes and actual /bin/date. An unproved step stays unproved; never infer acceptance or a global target result from a local/conditional theorem.
safety: Own root only, new immutable outputs. No nested agents, external-model/API calls, secrets, publication, deletion or infrastructure action. Complete new code before a bounded run; skip unrelated build/lint/unit-test/formatters. Real verification and honest failure, not a process STOP.
